description: Administer the index itself — one tool, one `action`. Nothing here answers a question about the CODE; that is dossier and search.

`action='status'` — which repository is active and WHERE THAT CAME FROM (`target_source`), plus database path, build version, indexed scope, freshness and query-tool state. Call it when an answer looks wrong, when an expected symbol is missing, or when the repository may have moved — NOT routinely, since every query reply already names the target it answered from and carries a staleness block only when there is one. THREE THINGS SET `stale` and need different actions, so read the `staleness` list: `data`, which action='refresh' fixes; `schema`, the stamped build version against the one this server expects, which no rebuild clears when the INDEX IS NEWER; `code`, this process older than the working tree, which only a client restart replaces and which makes a build through it refused.

`action='refresh'` — build or refresh a target's clew.db (skipped when current unless `force=true`). On success the query tools register and the tool list changes. Scope comes from the repo's own doxygen-guard declaration and defaults to COMPLETE. The reply measures its own cost — quote that rather than estimating one. `exclude=["path", ...]` is the only way to narrow the index: repo-relative paths, RECORDED and REPLAYED by every later build — omit to inherit, pass an empty list to withdraw. `options` states this repository's own conventions (accessor families, thread-spawn wrappers, locks, dispatch, predefined macros), keyed by the sections of a `.clew.yaml`, each a repo-relative path or the document inline; an unknown key is REFUSED by name. What to state is not a guess: see `status.diagnostics` and propose_declaration's `statement`, which this accepts verbatim. It REFUSES to build when this server process predates its own source; restart the client.
`action='targets'` — every indexed repository with its database age and staleness. `action='cull'` — delete aged-out or version-stale databases and forget them.

`action='stats'` — how much of THIS INDEX to trust: edge counts by layer and confidence, file coverage, per-layer populated/empty/absent state, and the doxygen-vs-parser split of the symbol rows. It grades the index, not the repository — a low-confidence graph is a reason to weigh an answer differently, not a finding about the code.

TWO ACTIONS ROUTE. `action='refresh'` and `action='stats'` take an optional `target` — a repo root path, or a slug from `action='targets'` — and answer about THAT repository; omit it and the derived target answers. The other three do not, and refuse a `target` by name rather than ignoring one: `status` reports on the derived target and where the derivation came from, `targets` already lists every repository, and `cull` is a registry-wide sweep with no per-target mode. To ask about a repository other than the default, ask it a question — every dossier and search reply names the target it answered from and carries a staleness block whenever there is one.
